# Quick Start
Quick Start by reading config files
Before starting:
Read and follow:
docs/ai-context.md
docs/domain-model.md
docs/repository-map.md

Do not create duplicate domain concepts.
Use existing entities wherever possible.
AvailabilityBlock is the canonical source for player unavailability.
PracticeSlot remains the canonical training-window entity.
Calendar functionality is implemented using FullCalendar.
Mobile-usage always in focus
